content: Thus, each coordinate of the sparsemax solution is a piecewise-linear function. Visibly, this expression is recovered when setting $\alpha =2$ in the $\alpha $-entmax expression (Equation DISPLAY_FORM85); for other values of $\alpha $, the exponent induces curvature.
